# Contributing to Mixdown

## Reporting Issues

We use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/mixdown-markup/mixdown/issues) to track bugs and feature requests.

Before opening a new issue, please search the existing issues to avoid duplicates.

When opening a new issue, please use one of the provided templates:

- [🐞 Bug Report](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/-bug-report.md)
- [❇️ Feature Request](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/-feature-request.md)
- [📜 Documentation Improvement](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/-documentation-improvement.md)
- [📝 Syntax Grammar Improvement](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/-syntax-grammar-improvement.md)
- [🧾 Request for Example(s)](./ISSUE_TEMPLATE/-request-for-example-s.md)

## Pull Requests

We use [GitHub Pull Requests](https://github.com/mixdown-markup/mixdown/pulls) to merge code.

## Code of Conduct

See our [Code of Conduct](./CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Attribution

This document is adapted from the [Contributing to Open Source](https://opensource.guide/how-to-contribute/) guide.
